items.title: ArcGIS Solutions 2026 Product Roadmap
items.summary: ArcGIS Solutions are industry-specific configurations of ArcGIS that align with your business needs, transform your use of ArcGIS, and help you maximize the investment you are making in location-based data and technology.

items.title: Internship with the Spatial Analyst Team at Esri, Summer 2026
items.summary: As a student with a strong interest in GIS, transportation, spatial analysis, and cartography, I have always been fascinated by how geospatial technology can help us better understand the world in more meaningful ways.

items.title: Strengthening democratic oversight in national security
items.summary: OpenAI is launching a new initiative to help democratic oversight bodies develop the expertise and tools they need to understand and oversee government use of AI for national security.

items.title: Partnering with CodeAI to prepare the first AI generation
items.summary: Today’s students will be the first generation to grow up with AI as part of everyday life.

items.title: Pacing model development in an era of cyber-critical capabilities
items.summary: Over the past several weeks, two developments have underscored the growing risks associated with increasingly capable AI systems: the OpenAI-Hugging Face incident and, separately, preliminary evidence that one of our upcoming models, Astra, may meet the Critical cybersecurity capability threshold under our Preparedness Framework .

items.title: Introducing ChatGPT for Teens: Built for learning, backed by protections
items.summary: We’re introducing ChatGPT for Teens, an experience designed to help teens learn, think critically, deepen understanding, and use AI with confidence.

items.title: Asana cleared 5 years of engineering work in 2 weeks with Codex
items.summary: Using OpenAI Codex, Asana replaced an outdated testing system in two weeks for about $12K.

items.title: We still don’t know how people are really using AI
items.summary: AI companies like Anthropic and OpenAI regularly publish reports on how people are using products like Claude and ChatGPT, but they only release the data they want us to see, AI researchers say.
